text:
Zoe: heads-up — hitting a weird stack: types + ESM/CJS exports + edge bundler when onboarding a new sample. TS complains about overloads/generics and the runtime ends up with undefined methods.
Liam: paste the exact TS errors and your tsconfig? quick guesses: moduleResolution and conditional exports are usual suspects.
Zoe: errors: \"TS2345: Argument of type 'unknown' is not assignable to parameter of type 'T'\" and \"No overload matches this call to client.execute()\". Runtime: 'client.invoke' is undefined in the worker.
Priya: what import form are you using?
Zoe: `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'` in the sample template.
Raj: switch to named import as immediate workaround: `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'`. Default interop is brittle when bundlers pick the CJS entrypoint.
Zoe: that fixed the runtime undefined method. But type inference for `client.run<{ x: number }>(...)` still fails under esbuild with moduleResolution: 'bundler'. Works if I switch to node16/nodeNext.
Liam: bundlers sometimes resolve the wrong types entry. Our package uses conditional exports and currently points types->./dist/index.d.ts. Some bundlers don't follow the export map for types which results in fallback to CJS d.ts.
Priya: quick unblock: add `skipLibCheck: true` and `preserveValueImports: false` to local tsconfig to force the expected path — but that's a hack. We should provide explicit tsconfigs in the examples.
Zoe: here's the minimal repro I used:
```
// example.ts
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'
const c = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RD_KEY })
const out = await c.chat<{ items: { id: string }[] }>('hi')
console.log(out.items[0].id)
```
Raj: two separate issues: (1) type resolution for overloads/generics across ESM/CJS and (2) runtime retry/auth differences in edge.
Priya: on 1 — possible fix: publish a small `types/edge/index.d.ts` and add it into the export map under an "edge" condition so bundlers can pick a stable types entry for worker targets.
Liam: also consider simplifying public signatures. Overloads can be implemented for JS ergonomics but their *.d.ts representation can confuse TS when combined with conditional types. Option: a single generic method `chat<T = unknown>(...)` and provide an opt-in `StrictChat` type in a separate package path for tighter typing.
Zoe: I'm worried about beginner DX. If we force `unknown` everywhere, newcomers get scary errors. If we use `any`, strict users suffer.
Priya: tradeoff plan: keep ergonomic `any`-friendly typedefs for primary package, and add `@redwood/inference/strict` (types-only) that exports fully-strict typings. Docs should show how to opt into strict mode.
Raj: on 2 — edge fetch/abort differences surfaced in retries. Our retry wrapper assumes a Node-style request that has `.destroy()` and certain error codes. Workers don't. I prototyped guards: detect platform (globalThis.fetch && !process) and use AbortController-based flow + no `.destroy()` calls.
Zoe: can you paste the guard snippet? would be helpful for the example.
Raj: sure:
```
function safeRetry(req, opts) {
  if (typeof globalThis.fetch === 'function' && typeof process === 'undefined') {
    // worker/edge: use AbortController, avoid node-only stream methods
    const ac = new AbortController()
    return fetch(req, { signal: ac.signal, ...opts }).catch(err => { /* edge-safe retry logic */ })
  }
  // node: use existing node retry logic that may use streams/destroy
}
```
Liam: we should also add a small test matrix in CI that builds examples with esbuild/rollup/webpack and runs TS checks with node16/node18 and TS 4.9/5.x.
Priya: action items: 
- Raj: add edge-safe guards to retry/auth code and tests for worker env (owner: Raj)
- Liam: update package.json export map to include a `types` path for edge and coordinate with build (owner: Liam)
- Zoe: add example tsconfig files in `examples/edge` (tsconfig.edge.json + README about imports and moduleResolution) (owner: Zoe)
- Priya: draft a typings strategy doc: ergonomic default + opt-in strict types package and sample imports (owner: Priya)
pkg-bot: created issue RED-900: "edge: typings + ESM/CJS parity + retry/auth worker guards" https://issues.internal/RED-900
Zoe: thanks — I'll push the example repo change and link it here. If anyone hits this earlier please drop a tiny repro or paste your tsconfig in #devex; reproducibility saved us last time. :pray:
